skill.title: DV01
skill.guidance: Read the requested field from the document image. Match its label or table row and column. Return only the requested value, name or phrase, not a sentence or the field label. Omit introductory a/an and numbering markers when they are not part of the requested value. Preserve actual spelling, digits and punctuation; do not expand abbreviations or normalize date/time formats. Answer directly when clear; use a crop only for an unresolved visual detail.

skill.title: DV02
skill.guidance: Identify the requested entity and its field: sender, recipient, person, employer, role and address are different. Follow the label-value alignment, including continuation lines belonging to that field. Exclude unrelated adjacent fields; retain qualifying words that are part of the requested name.

skill.title: DV03
skill.guidance: Locate the exact requested column and row, including year, measure and header hierarchy. For largest/smallest questions compare the eligible rows within that same column and return the winning row label. Do not compare a neighboring measure or mix a subtotal with its components. A useful crop retains the headers as well as the values.

skill.title: DV04
skill.guidance: For a list or contents page, match the exact item and its associated text or page value. For a printed page indicator, preserve the pagination text as it appears, excluding decorative framing. For an item or amendment number, return the identifier value rather than its printed field heading or enumeration marker.

skill.title: DV05
skill.guidance: For tiny text or handwriting, first locate the field on the full page using its label and surrounding layout. If the strokes are ambiguous, crop the label AND value with a generous margin. Inspect whether the returned crop actually contains that field before reading it. If it misses, relocate on the original page within the remaining tool budget. Distinguish written characters from dotted rules, crossings and decorative marks; preserve unusual spellings rather than replacing them with familiar ones.

skill.title: DV06
skill.guidance: Transcribe the visible numeric field as written. Preserve meaningful signs, decimals, zeros and separators; do not supply punctuation that is absent. A selected qualifier such as a time period or unit can be part of a value; an unrelated label is not. For a calculation, read the specified operands and units first, then compute only what is asked.

skill.title: DV07
skill.guidance: When asked about a figure, chart, arrow, checkbox, signature, stamp or diagram, reason from the actual marks and spatial relationships in the image, not only from nearby OCR-like text. Count distinct items carefully and distinguish checked from empty boxes.

skill.title: DV08
skill.guidance: Use arithmetic only when the question asks for a derived quantity. Read and label the needed operands from the image first. For difference use [from_value,to_value]; for ratio use [denominator,numerator]; for percent_change use [old_value,new_value]. The numeric Program checks arithmetic only, not the visual reading of operands.

skill.title: DV09
skill.guidance: Extract the requested entity or phrase from its local context. Do not include a preceding sentence article, field label, nearby job role or address. Retain modifiers that are part of a proper name or title. Copy the source spelling without paraphrasing.

skill.title: DV10
skill.guidance: Give only the requested value or entity, without an explanatory sentence, repeated question label or introductory article. Preserve the exact visible answer characters and necessary qualifiers. Do not silently normalize or correct the text.

program.title: Crop authorized DocVQA image region
program.goal: Crop and enlarge a relevant original-image region up to 3x, preferring lossless PNG, retaining source coordinates
program.source:
"""Image ROI tool for the actual DocVQA public image, not an OCR system.

Input path must be an AnswerAdapter worker_resources path mounted read-only at
/workspace/inputs/image_N.ext. It returns a bounded JPEG for the runtime's
multimodal bridge, plus dimensions and the exact region used.
"""
import base64
import hashlib
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
import re

from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageOps


def crop_bytes(raw, bbox, max_edge=1280, enhancement='none'):
    """Pure transform used by the Worker and by zero-HTTP fixture tests."""
    if (not isinstance(bbox, list) or len(bbox) != 4 or
            any(type(x) is not int or not 0 <= x <= 1000 for x in bbox) or
            not (bbox[0] < bbox[2] and bbox[1] < bbox[3])):
        raise ValueError('bbox must be [left,top,right,bottom] in [0,1000], nonempty')
    if type(max_edge) is not int or not 384 <= max_edge <= 1600:
        raise ValueError('max_edge must be 384..1600')
    if enhancement not in ('none', 'contrast', 'grayscale'):
        raise ValueError('Unsupported enhancement')
    with Image.open(BytesIO(raw)) as original:
        original.load()
        if original.width * original.height > 75_000_000:
            raise ValueError('Image is too large for a bounded crop')
        frame = ImageOps.exif_transpose(original).convert('RGB')
    width, height = frame.size
    x0 = max(0, min(width-1, round(width*bbox[0]/1000)))
    x1 = max(x0+1, min(width, round(width*bbox[2]/1000)))
    y0 = max(0, min(height-1, round(height*bbox[1]/1000)))
    y1 = max(y0+1, min(height, round(height*bbox[3]/1000)))
    region = frame.crop((x0,y0,x1,y1))
    if enhancement == 'grayscale':
        region = ImageOps.grayscale(region).convert('RGB')
    elif enhancement == 'contrast':
        region = ImageEnhance.Contrast(region).enhance(1.25)
    source_crop_width, source_crop_height = region.size
    scale = min(3.0, max_edge / max(region.size))
    region = region.resize((max(1, round(region.width * scale)),
                            max(1, round(region.height * scale))), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    # Prefer lossless line strokes; bound all formats by the same RPC ceiling.
    for fmt, quality in [('PNG', None), ('JPEG', 90), ('JPEG', 82), ('JPEG', 70)]:
        stream = BytesIO()
        region.save(stream, format=fmt, optimize=True, **({'quality': quality} if quality else {}))
        image_bytes = stream.getvalue()
        encoded = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode('ascii')
        if len(encoded) <= 680_000:
            return {'crop_base64':encoded,'image_mime':'image/png' if fmt=='PNG' else 'image/jpeg',
                    'image_sha256':hashlib.sha256(image_bytes).hexdigest(),
                    'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                    'source_width':width,'source_height':height,
                    'crop_width':region.width,'crop_height':region.height,
                    'resize_scale':scale,'source_crop_width':source_crop_width,'source_crop_height':source_crop_height,
                    'source_bbox_pixels':[x0,y0,x1,y1],
                    'bbox_normalized':bbox,
                    'scope':'crop_of_current_authorized_public_image_not_ocr'}
    raise ValueError('Compressed crop still exceeds the RPC payload bound')


REGIONS = {'top': [0, 0, 1000, 400], 'middle': [0, 300, 1000, 700],
           'bottom': [0, 600, 1000, 1000], 'left': [0, 0, 600, 1000],
           'right': [400, 0, 1000, 1000], 'whole': [0, 0, 1000, 1000]}


def run(ctx, inputs):
    try:
        path = inputs['image_path']
        if (not isinstance(path,str) or not re.fullmatch(
                r'/workspace/inputs/image_\d+\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|webp|gif|bmp)',path,re.I)):
            raise ValueError('Only an advertised /workspace/inputs/image_N.ext is allowed')
        source = Path(path)
        if not source.is_file() or source.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError('Authorized public image is not mounted')
        raw = source.read_bytes()
        if len(raw) > 33_554_432:
            raise ValueError('Input exceeds DocVQA frozen image-byte policy')
        if ('bbox' in inputs) == ('region' in inputs):
            raise ValueError('Provide exactly one of bbox or region')
        bbox = inputs['bbox'] if 'bbox' in inputs else REGIONS[inputs['region']]
        outputs = crop_bytes(raw, bbox,inputs.get('max_edge',1280),
                             inputs.get('enhancement','none'))
        return {'status':'ok','outputs':outputs}
    except (KeyError,ValueError,OSError,TypeError) as exc:
        return {'status':'needs_input','outputs':{},'detail':str(exc)[:400]}

image_path.description: Use the exact path advertised in worker_resources, e.g. /workspace/inputs/image_0.png.

bbox.description: [left,top,right,bottom] in normalized 0..1000 coordinates of the ORIGINAL image; left<right, top<bottom.

enhancement.description: Prefer none to preserve original strokes; contrast/grayscale are optional views, not OCR.

region.description: Broad region of the ORIGINAL page with overlapping margins. Use this OR bbox.

program.title: Exact arithmetic from model-observed document numbers
program.goal: Compute simple quantitative operations on actual model-transcribed operands

values.description: Read operands from the image. difference/absolute_difference: [from_value,to_value]; ratio: [denominator,numerator]; percent_change: [old_value,new_value].

entry_constraints.scope: Only numerical values actually observed by the current model from the image

program.title: Compare candidate with model-provided transcription
program.goal: Check string and anchor occurrence in a model-supplied visual transcription, never certify the image

entry_constraints.scope: Model-supplied transcription only; check the image separately

workflow.title: ROI zoom then answer
workflow.goal: Read a small or handwritten region of an original document image

nodes.goal: Inspect the original image; locate the question target. Output bbox (0..1000) and the exact advertised worker_resources image_path; do not invent text.
Read the actual cropped image, verify it against original spatial context and return only the answer.

workflow.title: Read values then deterministic arithmetic
workflow.goal: Compute a numeric answer using operands read from the actual image

nodes.goal: Read every needed operand and order it correctly from the original image, returning operation/values/unit.
Use the computed numeric result only if its operands match the image and the requested target; return exact final answer.

workflow.title: Visual transcript and anchored check
workflow.goal: Read an exact text answer from a crowded form or handwritten label

nodes.goal: Read the image near the requested label and propose candidate, observed_text, and anchor; retain visual uncertainty.
Return exact target from original image; note text check verifies only transcription self-consistency.
